Tier2 link conversion with accessible names enabled

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{"inline_data_media":"AltTextOnly","tier_strategy":"Tier2"}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convertWithAccessibleNames('<p>see <a href="https://example.com/x">GitHub<svg aria-label="(opens in new tab)"><use href="#ext"></use></svg></a> now</p>', true, options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result.content);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
